data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals is a public-stage biotech company that has raised over $2 billion and currently trades at a $1.6 billion valuation. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 11 comparable companies across Biotech & Health—3 public-market comps and 8 private peers—including Freenome, Alto Neuroscience, and Eikon Therapeutics.

Peer-median valuation analysis, the applicable triangulation method here, identifies a median valuation of $1.0 billion across three same-sector, same-stage peers. The comparable universe spans a range from $539 million (Eikon Therapeutics) to $1.1 billion (Freenome), establishing a floor and ceiling for similarly-staged biotech platforms. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (8.1x median across three public tickers: RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied, as private company revenue figures are not on file.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $884 million to $1.2 billion, centered on a median of $1.0 billion. Recursion's current $1.6 billion valuation sits 54 percent above the peer median, introducing material valuation risk or signaling differential expectations around pipeline depth, capital efficiency, or market position relative to the comparable set. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue-based triangulation and the limited sample size of directly comparable public exits in the frontier biotech space.
